1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any
   contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The record-once clause is where the bootstrap's ordered record step meets the append form and the caller's decision whether to write; the gate forces the clause to answer to the sequence without re-deciding the append or the order. Both nodes are requirement sentences, so the cell is the matrix default — the gate plus a flag to extend the matrix.
